newsitem.title: USA: KCPL recommends holders to not tender shrs.
newsitem.headline: KCPL recommends holders to not tender shrs.

text.p: Kansas City Power & Light Co said Sunday that it continues to recommend that shareholders not tender their shares to Western Resources Inc.
KCPL said that unless Western determines to let its exchange offer terminate, it will be required to extend its offer from time to time for a "substantial" period of time.
KCPL said that Western's offer has been open since July and that since then a little more than 40 percent of the company's shares outstanding were tendered to Western.
Earlier on Sunday, Western Resources said that more than 44 percent of KCPL shares have been tendered and that it has extended its offer deadline to Novemer 15, 1996.
